description: A man with short dark hair in bronze armour and a red cloak with a purple sash holds a lit seven-branched candelabra high in his right hand, and a curved sword hangs low in his left. He stands beside a weathered stone column wrapped in ivy, under a dark stormy sky, with broken stones and rubble on the ground. The painting sits on a white background with a grey drop shadow, like a print mounted on a wall, and a faint painter's mark is in the lower right.
reason: The painting sits on a white margin with a grey drop shadow, so it reads as a print on a wall rather than filling the image edge to edge.
